verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented public API for programmatically driving ZCode. What exists is adjacent only: CLI launch flags and a token-protected web UI, a plugin-facing "页面 API" (page API) for building extensions, and remote triggering through WeChat, Feishu or Telegram chat apps. None of these is a documented public API for controlling the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
